Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the first place named in the Book of Esther (NIV) as “Susa.” In the NIV, Esther 1:1 first names “India” (followed by “Cush”), with “Susa” only appearing in 1:2. This led the agent to map the place to Iran and give Amir-Abbas Hoveyda as PM, whereas the correct place is India, whose Prime Minister in April 1977 was Morarji Desai. The error arose from not verifying the exact NIV wording and relying on assumed context.
